program.name: Strength Express
program.subject: Strength
program.blurb: Three lifts in straight sets and one closing superset, under half an hour.
program.about: Strength for the days with less time. Three lifts in straight sets come first, a squat or hinge, a press and a row, then one superset of two more moves to finish. Two days alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Three lifts and one superset, A / B
